scope: Independent source/package review for exact Debian trixie amd64 GCC runtime packages 14.2.0-19; not an assertion that all third-party native consumers are unaffected.

aligned_new.source_reason: GCC14.2 chooses POSIX_MEMALIGN before ALIGNED_ALLOC and compiles out the vulnerable size-rounding expression when POSIX_MEMALIGN is enabled.
aligned_new.independent_comparison: Official Debian payload library SHA256 equals parent-reported actual runtime library SHA256 exactly.
aligned_new.remaining_verification: Release CI must run the bounded aligned-new behavior probe against the actual candidate image and require the exact package/library identities.

runtime_verification.conditions: Disposable nonroot read-only, no network, 1 CPU, 128 MiB container; exact candidate image repeats this check in CI.

pbds_binary_heap.actual_development_package_observation: The exact14.2.0-19 developer package erase_if body lacks the m_a_entries assignment after deallocating old storage; this header is vulnerable.
pbds_binary_heap.affected_consumer: A binary instantiating __gnu_pbds::priority_queue with binary_heap_tag and invoking erase_if; generic std::priority_queue alone is not the affected GNU extension.
pbds_binary_heap.minimal_remediation_if_instantiated: Backport upstream m_a_entries = new_entries after deallocation in the build header and rebuild each affected native consumer. Replacing runtime libstdc++ alone cannot replace already-instantiated template code.
pbds_binary_heap.runtime_package_scope: The four exact Grype-matched runtime package payloads contain runtime libraries/metadata, not this template header. Manifest pinning may support this package-specific disposition only.
limitations: No full-image or all-native-dependencies unaffected claim follows from runtime header/compiler absence.
Absence of exported __gnu_pbds symbols is not sufficient because templates can be inlined.
A compiler used only in a builder can still embed vulnerable header code into a shipped shared object.
pbds_binary_heap.additional_source_review_method: Scanned every regular source archive member below 10 MB for __gnu_pbds, ext/pb_ds and binary_heap_tag; OpenCV excludes only its binary trainingfaces_24-24.vec dataset. These supplemental checks are not proof about every third-party binary wheel.

runtime_manifest_conditions.identity: Exact dpkg package versions/status and owned paths; official payload hashes and symlink targets; immutable scanned-image identity enforced by image_advisory_policy.
runtime_manifest_conditions.slim_metadata: Missing documentation/GDB printer metadata and lintian override files are permitted; existing files must match official hashes. Runtime libraries are mandatory.
runtime_manifest_conditions.observed_slim_rule: /etc/dpkg/dpkg.cfg.d/docker contains path-exclude /usr/share/lintian/overrides/*; absent libgcc-s1 lintian override was verified in the retained image.
runtime_manifest_conditions.scope_guard: Executable policy restricts both advisories to four package/version tuples each; a JSON-only extension to a new package/version is rejected.

complete_guard_verification.conditions: Parent-run disposable nonroot read-only container from a retained image, no network or production mounts, 1 CPU and128 MiB; no stderr/OOM. The final release candidate must independently rerun the guard after scanner-to-image identity validation in CI.
complete_guard_verification.independent_review: Official four-package manifest and code scope independently reviewed;14 focused tests independently passed.
